pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (evaluation order and the exponentiation exceptions, mode-independent), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 (32-digit standard intermediate) and §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 (rounding to 31 digits on compare, on a function argument with no equivalent expression, on a store without ROUNDED), §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation), and §2002:15 / §2002:15.1 (the same six function types; 2002 15.1 says the definition gives an alphanumeric/national function's character positions). The documented seed subset (0..32767 at least) is a property of the generator, not of standard arithmetic; the seeds are 5-digit integers, far inside 31 digits. No change; the reader's rnddist-2002 and DOC-A.1-145 stand.
